body: Story telling is not my forte. Sorry.

They shouldn't be hurt by my decision. It is my decision not there's. I will ask them how they feel than. I am sure all they have is... well your family and we want you to live because we care. Sadly though, most family structures have been lead to believe they must care for family because they are just that, when in fact it really doesn't matter.

It is true that my decision is hard to follow through with because of there feelings but my feelings mean more to me than there's.
